Subject: Feedback regarding my recent stay

Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I received during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the efforts of [Employee Name 1] at the front desk and [Employee Name 2] in the restaurant. Their attentiveness, professionalism, and warm hospitality truly made my stay memorable and left a lasting positive impression.

Because of the high standard of service and the welcoming atmosphere, I would highly recommend your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to returning in the future.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]
